elements.element: Services are performed in a professional manner.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(1) warrants that the Services will be performed “in a professional manner.”

elements.element: Services are performed in a workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(1) warrants that the Services will be performed “in a workmanlike manner.”

elements.element: Services conform to their documentation for 90 days.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(1) warrants conformity to documentation for 90 days following performance of the Services.

elements.element: Deliverables conform to their documentation for 12 months.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(2) warrants that each deliverable will conform to its documentation for 12 months following delivery.

elements.element: Software conforms to its documentation for 12 months.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(2) warrants that each item of software, including the Site, will conform to its documentation for 12 months following delivery.

elements.element: Repair is available as a remedy for breach of the performance warranties.
elements.evidence: The final sentence identifies repair as a remedy for breach of Section 9(c).

elements.element: Replacement is available as a remedy for breach of the performance warranties.
elements.evidence: The final sentence identifies replacement as a remedy for breach of Section 9(c).

elements.element: Refund is available as a remedy for breach of the performance warranties.
elements.evidence: The final sentence provides a refund of fees paid for the non-conforming Services, deliverable, or software.

elements.element: Services are performed in compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(3) expressly requires HDI to perform the Services in compliance with all applicable laws.

elements.element: The Site, software, and other provided materials contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(4) warrants that the Site and any software or other materials provided by HDI will not contain any virus, worm, disabling device, or other malicious code.

elements.element: Software conforms to its documentation for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: The clause provides a 12-month software conformance warranty, exceeding the 90-day fallback period.

elements.element: Services conform to their documentation for at least 30 days.
elements.evidence: The clause provides a 90-day Services conformance warranty, exceeding the 30-day fallback period.

elements.element: Repair is available as a remedy under the fallback warranty.
elements.evidence: Repair is expressly listed as a remedy for breach of Section 9(c).

elements.element: Replacement is available as a remedy under the fallback warranty.
elements.evidence: Replacement is expressly listed as a remedy for breach of Section 9(c).

elements.element: Refund is available as a remedy under the fallback warranty.
elements.evidence: A refund of applicable fees is expressly listed as a remedy for non-conforming Services or software.

result.reason: The added operative language satisfies the complete preferred warranty package and therefore also exceeds the fallback durations. The original Globix provision remains unchanged, and the amendment adds no unrelated commercial requirement. Drafting is substantively complete, although the remedy sentence could be clearer about who elects among repair, replacement, and refund and how the post-performance period applies to ongoing Services.
